title: PyMolGen: Database-Driven Molecular Generation of Drug-Like Compounds.
authors: Falcone, Bruno N; Hutcheon, Michael J; Zaidi, Jaffer M; Stocks, Michael J; Hamill, Kirsty E; Jamieson, Craig; Williams, Huw J; Palmer, David S; Baxter, Andrew; Pickett, Stephen D; Hirst, Jonathan D
journal: Journal of chemical information and modeling
one_liner_zh: 该文基于规则从数据库生成类药分子，用于药物发现，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: We present a rule-based approach for the generation of new molecules, which derives combination rules between molecular fragments from a user-provided database, and is useful for constrained optimization at defined vectors. The molecules generated are statistically similar to the database provided. Compared to existing machine-learning approaches this affords the user a greater level of control of the molecules generated, which is a common desideratum in drug discovery programs. This is complemented by the use of a build probability score for each generated molecule, which corresponds to the likelihood of its existence in a hypothetical exhaustive enumeration of the source database fragments. The method is applied to the generation of derivatives of a 3,5-dimethyl-4-phenylisoxazole parent structure, a core of current interest for the development of inhibitors of bromodomain-containing protein 4.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种基于规则的新分子生成方法，该方法从用户提供的数据库中推导分子片段之间的组合规则，并适用于在定义向量上的约束优化。生成的分子在统计上与所提供的数据库相似。与现有的机器学习方法相比，这为用户提供了对生成分子更高水平的控制，这是药物发现项目中常见的需求。此外，每个生成的分子还配有一个构建概率评分，该评分对应于其在源数据库片段假设性穷举枚举中存在的可能性。该方法被应用于生成3,5-二甲基-4-苯基异噁唑母体结构的衍生物，该母体结构是当前开发含溴结构域蛋白4抑制剂研究中的核心。
